    Pre-Intervention Common Trends Test for multiout_synth Objects

    pretrend_test.Rd

    Evaluates whether the synthetic control tracks the treated group during the pre-treatment period by splitting the L balanced lags into a training sub-period and a held-out test sub-period, then testing whether the gaps in the test sub-period are jointly zero.

    pretrend_test(
  fit,
  Y_list,
  treat_time,
  L,
  outcomes = NULL,
  min_pre_periods = 3L,
  test_fraction = 0.3,
  standardize_outcomes = FALSE,
  intercept = c("none", "outcome", "global"),
  time_weights = NULL,
  eps_sd = 1e-08,
  alpha = 0.05,
  verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    fit

    List returned by multiout_synth().

    Y_list

    Named list of \(N \times T\) outcome matrices (unit rows, time-period columns).

    treat_time

    Numeric vector length \(N\); first treated column index per unit (Inf = never treated).

    L

    Integer; number of pre-treatment lags balanced.

    outcomes

    Character vector of outcome names to test. Defaults to names(Y_list).

    min_pre_periods

    Integer. Minimum required pre-treatment lags. Error if L < min_pre_periods. Default 3L.

    test_fraction

    Numeric in (0, 1). Share of the L lags reserved as the placebo test window. Default 0.3.

    standardize_outcomes

    Logical. If TRUE, standardise each outcome per treated unit using the donor-pool pre-treatment mean and SD, matching build_Xy_for_unit. Default FALSE.

    intercept

    Character. Intercept removal matching the intercept argument passed to multiout_synth:

    "none"

    No demeaning (default).

    "outcome"

    Remove the (time-weighted) pre-treatment mean from both the treated trajectory and the synthetic control trajectory, per outcome per treated unit, using all L lags as the reference. This replicates demean_within_outcome_blocks and removes level differences so the test focuses purely on trend shape.

    "global"

    Remove a single (time-weighted) grand mean across all outcomes and lags. Use when multiout_synth was called with intercept = "global".

    time_weights

    Optional numeric vector of length L. Lag weights used in the (time-)weighted mean when demeaning. Must match the time_weights argument passed to multiout_synth. Default NULL (uniform weights).

    eps_sd

    Small positive floor for SD when standardising. Default 1e-8.

    alpha

    Significance level. Default 0.05.

    verbose

    Logical. Print summary table. Default TRUE.

    Value

    A named list (one element per outcome) each containing:

    outcome

    Outcome name.

    gaps_test

    Named numeric vector of average gaps in the test sub-period (one value per lag, averaged across treated units).

    gaps_train

    Average gaps in the training sub-period.

    rmse_train

    RMSE of gaps in the training sub-period.

    rmse_test

    RMSE of gaps in the test sub-period.

    rmse_ratio

    rmse_test / rmse_train.

    statistic

    F-statistic (NA if n_test = 1).

    df1, df2

    Degrees of freedom.

    p_value

    p-value.

    reject

    Logical: rejected at alpha?

    train_lags, test_lags

    Integer vectors of the column indices used as training / test lags (relative to the matrix).

    standardized

    Logical: were gaps computed on standardised scale?

    Standardisation

    If standardize_outcomes = TRUE, each outcome is standardised per treated unit using the same procedure as build_Xy_for_unit: the donor-pool mean and SD are computed over that unit's donor set and its L pre-treatment columns, then subtracted / divided before computing gaps. This ensures the test is conducted on the same scale the solver used when fitting weights. Set this to TRUE whenever multiout_synth was called with standardize_outcomes = TRUE.

    See also

    balance_table for a summary balance table.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Match the standardize_outcomes flag used in multiout_synth
res <- pretrend_test(
  fit                  = fit,
  Y_list               = Y_list,
  treat_time           = treat_time,
  L                    = L,
  standardize_outcomes = TRUE   # if multiout_synth was called with TRUE
)

plot_pretrend(res)
} # }
